title: Tiny Swords: Warfare
author: Pixel Frog
summary: Combat expansion for Tiny Swords: warriors with their own weapons, animations and fighting styles in 5 unit colours, plus siege weapons, military buildings and fortifications. PNG images with Aseprite files, one 2.9 MB ZIP.
engineNote: No engine project is named on the page; it documents PNG images plus Aseprite source files, so atlas slicing and import settings are manual work in Unity, Godot, GameMaker or any 2D engine.
licenseNote: The page states 'Feel free to use this asset pack in both personal and commercial projects, modifying the assets as needed', crediting not required but welcome, and 'You may not redistribute, resell, or repackage the assets, even if the files are modified'. No paid download was made.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $30.00 crossed out to $15.00; the structured Offer price is 15 USD. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: Pixel Frog's documented combat set - multiple warrior types with per-unit animations in 5 faction colours, siege weapons, military buildings and fortifications, PNG plus Aseprite source - is half the $30 list price at $15, which is far below the usual cost for a documented pack of this scope from this publisher. Completeness is graded 3 because the page marks the product 'In development' with content still on the roadmap, and the ZIP was not opened.

title: All Fonts Pack
author: Chequered Ink
summary: Over 1200 commercial OTF and TTF font styles by Chequered Ink in one 23 MB sorted ZIP. The page documents full commercial use for small businesses and names the archive on the product page.
engineNote: The page lists Chequered Ink All Fonts Pack Sorted.zip with OTF and TTF inside. No engine project was verified; install fonts manually.
licenseNote: The page states pay-once unlimited commercial use for qualifying small businesses and links separate license terms. The archive was not downloaded.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $190 crossed out to $19. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: 1200+ named font styles in one sorted 23 MB ZIP with 156 ratings at 5.0 and an explicit pay-once commercial grant. Value is exceptional at 90% off $190; the small-business eligibility cap is a licence qualification, not a usage restriction on projects. Individual font files were not audited.
